name: token-optimizer-mcp
install_doc: README 'Quick start' -> Claude Code (https://github.com/ooples/token-optimizer-mcp#quick-start): '/plugin marketplace add ooples/token-optimizer-mcp', '/plugin install token-optimizer@token-optimizer', '/reload-plugins'. Those are interactive slash commands inside a running Claude Code session, so per CONTRIBUTING rule 1 they are not run in the harness. Instead setup_commands runs the package's own documented non-interactive installer, `token-optimizer-install`, which wires exactly the hooks the plugin installs into the sandboxed HOME's settings.json (scripts/install-cli.mjs -> wire-hooks.mjs, writing $HOME/.claude/settings.json). That installer does not register the MCP server, which the plugin install does, so the `mcp` block below is transcribed verbatim from plugin/.mcp.json with ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} resolved to the global npm install path. Nothing else is altered and no harness special-casing is required.
notes: MCP server + five Claude Code lifecycle hooks. The hooks are the product: the README states that adding the bare MCP server alone 'just gives the model tools it can ignore'. SessionStart injects the project's knowledge graph; PreToolUse routes Read/Grep/Glob/Edit/Write/Bash/WebFetch/WebSearch toward the compressing smart_* equivalents and can rewrite a command via updatedInput rather than refusing it; PreCompact optimizes the transcript before the client compacts; PostToolUse records edits and compacts noisy command output; Stop harvests durable findings into the graph for the next session. VERSION PINNING: plugin/launch.mjs normally tracks the `latest` dist-tag and re-resolves it per cold runtime, which under THOL's throwaway HOME would let the measured version drift mid-campaign. TOKEN_OPTIMIZER_VERSION is the shipped, documented exact-version pin for precisely this case: it refuses anything that is not an exact version, installs that version, and disables the background refresh. It is a product feature, not a harness deviation. DEFAULT POSTURE: 7.1.0 ships `assist` (hooks-core/policy.mjs mode() returns MODE_ASSIST when TOKEN_OPTIMIZER_MODE is unset). Earlier versions referenced in setup/install_competitors.sh (5.0.1) shipped `enforce`, a materially different and worse-measuring posture; this entry measures what a user installs today.
